caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, shallow dish with slightly flared sides and rounded corners, oriented at an angle so both the inner and part of the outer surfaces are visible. The dish is primarily red in color with decorative motifs on the interior and rim. The interior features golden yellow leafy patterns on the shorter sides and stylized green foliate designs mixed with some red and white elements on the inner longer sides. The rim is outlined with a similar golden yellow decorative border, featuring repeated curved shapes that resemble scallops or leaves. The background is plain and off-white, with a faint shadow cast by the dish to the lower right, indicating a light source from the upper left. The overall composition is centered, and there are no other objects present in the image.
title: Tray
